paragraphs: With a decade-long tenure spanning leadership and technical capacities, my professional trajectory has been defined by a steadfast commitment to driving technological innovation and enhancing operational efficiency. At the heart of my professional path is a deep-seated passion for leveraging technology to solve complex problems and drive business success.

As an IT Coordinator at ZHYTLOBUD-2, I orchestrated critical initiatives aimed at infrastructure modernization, data security fortification, and process optimization, affirming my proficiency in implementing substantial technological improvement.

My relocation to Canada was a career milestone, steering me towards technically demanding roles. Although Java forms the cornerstone of my expertise, developed through extensive study and a mentorship at EPAM Systems, the demands of my current position have expanded my skill set to include JavaScript and PHP. This adaptation showcases my commitment to meeting the evolving needs of the tech landscape.

My pursuit of continual professional advancement is demonstrated through the acquisition of certifications from esteemed entities such as AWS, Google Cloud, Meta, and Salesforce. This dedication ensures my expertise remains at the cutting edge of cloud architecture, serverless technologies, and data security protocols.

Moreover, my entrepreneurial ventures have instilled in me a strategic business insight, blending technical expertise with a comprehensive understanding of business needs. This unique perspective enables me to see the bigger picture, ensuring that technology solutions not only meet technical requirements but also drive business value.
